evidence.title: A feição Pantheon+ é robusta?
evidence.question: Does Pantheon+ require a physical z~0.43 transition after covariance and survey calibration stress?
evidence.meaning: A feição residual Pantheon+ em z ≈ 0,4 não exigiu uma transição física após covariância e nulls estruturados. Não é uma detecção; efeitos look-elsewhere não autorizam promover o sinal.
evidence.limitations: No new Pantheon refit; uses uploaded paper's frozen result.
evidence.dataset: Uploaded MNRAS draft Pantheon+ full-covariance step/injection analysis
evidence.next_gate: Use survey/covariance calibration operator in unified pipeline.

audit.question: Does Pantheon+ require a physical z~0.43 transition after covariance and survey calibration stress?
audit.dataset_stack: Uploaded MNRAS draft Pantheon+ full-covariance step/injection analysis
audit.key_metrics: localized step DeltaChi2=1.597; Gaussian covariance null p=.788; survey-offset null p=.855
audit.claim_impact: Physical transition is not independently required.
audit.notes: No new Pantheon refit; uses uploaded paper's frozen result.

evidence.title: Evolução ou calibração acústica?
evidence.question: Does DESI DR2 require wa!=0 after exposing the acoustic-ruler calibration coordinate?
evidence.meaning: A necessidade independente de wa ≠ 0 não sobreviveu à exposição da calibração da régua acústica neste diagnóstico; não refuta energia escura dinâmica globalmente.
evidence.limitations: Calibration here is acoustic-model calibration, not measurement pipeline error.
evidence.dataset: Uploaded MNRAS draft acoustic non-identifiability analysis
evidence.next_gate: Treat rd as inference/model calibration, not DESI hardware systematic.

audit.question: Does DESI DR2 require wa!=0 after exposing the acoustic-ruler calibration coordinate?
audit.dataset_stack: Uploaded MNRAS draft acoustic non-identifiability analysis
audit.claim_impact: Time-varying wa is not independently required once ruler calibration is exposed.
audit.notes: Calibration here is acoustic-model calibration, not measurement pipeline error.

evidence.title: A alavanca DESI vem de um único traçador?
evidence.question: Tracer-family transport of DESI ShapeFit discriminator
evidence.meaning: O discriminante DESI comprimido não é exclusivamente LRG; a evidência é heterogênea entre traçadores. Não equivale a uma detecção em likelihood nativa.

audit.question: Tracer-family transport of DESI ShapeFit discriminator
audit.claim_impact: Not an LRG-only artifact; evidence is heterogeneously distributed

evidence.title: O discriminante é robusto aos holdouts?
evidence.question: After profiling growth plus common shape, does residual DESI ordering survive all single-bin holdouts?
evidence.meaning: A preferência escalar residual comprimida falha na robustez de holdouts após perfilar crescimento e forma comum. Preserva a contradição com o transporte entre traçadores.
evidence.limitations: Compressed likelihood only; ELG2 holdout sign flip is controlling robustness failure.
evidence.dataset: DESI DR1 ShapeFit+BAO after global growth+common-shape profile
evidence.next_gate: Native full modelling with per-tracer nuisance posteriors.

evidence.title: Um vazio local resolve integralmente H0?
evidence.question: Do direct CosmicFlows-4 distance tracers support the Gpc-scale KBC local-supervoid configuration as a complete Planck-background solution of the Hubble tension?
evidence.meaning: Distâncias CosmicFlows-4 desfavorecem o vazio KBC de escala Gpc como solução completa genérica de H0. Correções ambientais menores permanecem possíveis.
evidence.limitations: TEST_CLASS=DECISIVE; EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN=HIGH; DECISION_IMPACT=HIGH. Local-environment rival closure; not new global H0 likelihood. NO_CLAIM_PROMOTION.
evidence.dataset: MNRAS 543,1556 (2025) field-level CosmicFlows-4 Tully-Fisher direct-distance test; canonical latest ladder context T-H0-JWST-RESIDUAL-001.
evidence.next_gate: Do not repeat broad H0 residual arithmetic. Reopen only with materially improved direct-distance/velocity mapping or a field-level joint local-environment likelihood.

audit.question: Do direct CosmicFlows-4 distance tracers support the Gpc-scale KBC local-supervoid configuration as a complete Planck-background solution of the Hubble tension?
audit.dataset_stack: MNRAS 543,1556 (2025) field-level CosmicFlows-4 Tully-Fisher direct-distance test; canonical latest ladder context T-H0-JWST-RESIDUAL-001.
audit.key_metrics: Preferred size <=70 Mpc. Predicted H0 exp=72.1 +0.9/-0.8, Gaussian=70.4±0.4, MB=70.2 +0.5/-0.4. Versus canonical latest ladder 73.49±0.93: residual 1.10σ, 3.05σ, 3.18σ.
audit.claim_impact: MORTA for Gpc-scale KBC void as a complete generic Planck-background H0 solution under current direct-distance evidence; smaller environmental corrections remain viable.
audit.notes: TEST_CLASS=DECISIVE; EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN=HIGH; DECISION_IMPACT=HIGH. Local-environment rival closure; not new global H0 likelihood. NO_CLAIM_PROMOTION.

evidence.title: Geometria tardia seleciona H0 elevado?
evidence.question: Does the exact requested stack using all 1701 Pantheon+ rows with the full 1701x1701 STAT+SYS covariance, free M_B, DESI DR2 full-cov BAO and canonical CC select a nonzero PEER amplitude and move H0 to >=70.8 without a local-ladder anchor?
evidence.meaning: O ajuste Pantheon+ completo, BAO e cronômetros com M_B livre não seleciona amplitude PEER não nula nem gera a solução de H0 elevado. A conclusão é específica deste stack.
evidence.limitations: Conditional background profile, not a full global PEER MCMC. ombh2/ns/As/tau and PEER zc/theta_i are fixed. CC local surface is certified only through H0=70.867186; H0>70.867 is not promoted. No formal PEER upper limit, posterior probability or Bayes factor is claimed.
evidence.dataset: Pantheon+ all 1701 rows with full 1701x1701 STAT+SYS covariance, M_B analytically profiled/free; DESI DR2 ALL_GCcomb 13-vector full covariance; canonical CC local quadratic surface trained on 12 exact CCHzDiag evaluations; portable CAMB 1.6.6; PEER n=3, log10(zc)=3.81, theta_i=2.89155, model-consistent rdrag; no Cepheid/TRGB/JAGB/SH0ES anchor.
evidence.next_gate: Add the matched CMB acoustic likelihood to this exact full-1701 contract, allow CMB-relevant parameters to vary, preserve free M_B and keep the local ladder strictly as holdout. Test whether posterior mass moves from f=0 to the f~0.06-0.08 / H0~70.4-70.8 basin.
